assumptions.choice: Only one trade (primary or one auxiliary sub-strategy) may be open at a time, priority order primary > squeeze-breakout > gap-continuation > trend-scalp; auxiliary sub-strategies never run concurrently.
assumptions.reason: backtrader maintains a single net broker position per data feed, so independent simultaneous primary+auxiliary (or multi-auxiliary) positions on the same single AAPL feed cannot be represented; this also trivially satisfies the '<=10% total auxiliary exposure' rule.

assumptions.choice: Entry-trigger window implemented as: whenever the rolling 5-bar panic condition is true, a 10-bar countdown (re)starts; the crossover entry trigger is only accepted while that countdown is <=10.
assumptions.reason: spec states panic is checked over 'any of the last 5 bars' and the entry trigger must fire 'within 10 bars after' the detector, but doesn't define how the two rolling windows compose; this is the most literal chaining of the two stated windows.

assumptions.choice: Protective exit condition 'CrossOver(EMA(50),EMA(20)) down' implemented with the same crossover indicator/sign used for the entry's 'CrossOver(EMA(20),EMA(50)) up' (CrossOver(a,b) down and CrossOver(b,a) up are the same event).
assumptions.reason: the two conditions are mathematically identical events under backtrader's CrossOver semantics; implemented exactly as written rather than substituting the (more conventional) death-cross reading.

assumptions.choice: Daily gap detection (Strategy 2) derived from the 5m feed via trading-day boundary detection: 'yesterday' close/ATR/BB values are the last 5m bar's values before the date changes, 'today' open is the first 5m bar's open of the new date.
assumptions.reason: the feed is 5-minute bars, not daily bars; no separate daily data source is available, so session-boundary aggregation on the existing feed is the closest literal reading.

assumptions.choice: A detected gap stays 'armed' only for the trading day on which it triggers; it is cleared (and re-evaluated) at the next day boundary.
assumptions.reason: spec gives no explicit expiry for the gap-continuation setup prior to entry.

assumptions.choice: Squeeze compression filter (Strategy 1) is required to hold on the same bar as the breakout crossover.
assumptions.reason: spec does not state a separate lag/lookback between the compression state and the breakout bar.

assumptions.choice: Pullback 'touch' of EMA20/Bollinger-mid (Strategies 2 and 3) implemented as Close <= level for longs / Close >= level for shorts, rather than an exact-touch tolerance.
assumptions.reason: spec doesn't define a tolerance band for the pullback touch.

assumptions.choice: Strategy 2 short-side stochastic zone mirrored as %K > 80 (long side uses < 20).
assumptions.reason: spec states the long threshold explicitly and says the short side is 'mirrored' without giving a number; 80 is the symmetric mirror of 20.

assumptions.choice: Strategy 3 time-stop implemented literally as 8 bars, per the explicit numeric rule, rather than converted from the descriptive '120-180 minutes' framing text.
assumptions.reason: the explicit stated parameter (8 bars) is the concrete rule; the minute range is background/title description.

assumptions.choice: All stop-loss, take-profit, trailing-stop, and time-stop checks are evaluated against bar Close and executed via self.close()/self.buy()/self.sell() market orders each bar, rather than backtrader Stop/Limit/StopTrail order types.
assumptions.reason: the spec's stop/target levels are recomputed from ATR/EMA/Bollinger values that change bar to bar (especially the trailing stop), which does not map onto backtrader's built-in fixed-parameter stop-order types; manual per-bar evaluation lets every stated formula be applied exactly.
